confidence_notes: Food and coffee anchors draw on Amsterdam cost-of-living data near the July 2026 window. Cocktail and wine estimates use local drink-price benchmarks, with wine set near the city's beer price. Accommodation is a holistic estimate and is less certain because I did not inspect booking listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Amsterdam's heavier international visitor demand suggests higher year-typical accommodation prices than the supplied Dutch comparables. The three-star estimate is about $210 per room versus $148–171 in Rotterdam, Utrecht, Delft, and Maastricht; basic rooms and hostel options are also estimated above those cities.
